title: Implementation Consultant, ERP
jobDescription: Job Description About the Role In this opportunity as an Implementation Consultant, you will: Ability to develop complex Object-Oriented ABAP objects independently. Ability to articulate solution and implementation process to the customers. Performing ABAP programming in both ECC & S4 HANA, Migration, testing, and debugging activities related to the implementation, Upgrade, enhancement etc. Should assist customers to integrate ONESOURCE Determination and SAP. Lead requirements and analysis workshops with clients to define business, process, functional and data mapping requirements. Perform Pricing and Tax related configurations for SD, MM and FI modules and develop ABAP. Analyze SAP code and functionality to design and develop custom solutions as per requirements. Configure ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Global Next for integration with SAP. Coordinate technical implementation with the client, providing technical expertise necessary to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues. Prepare and execute test scripts and test cases. Ability to maintain SAP ECC, S/4HANA system and take care of simple maintenance tasks like User maintenance, Authorizations, Archiving. Write Technical design document before development activities. You will provide domain expertise in SAP Ariba and business processes in support of building clearly defined business requirements and converting them into competitive, robust and flexible designs. title: Director Customer to Cash
jobDescription: The Customer to Cash Director will lead the end-to-end Customer to Cash function for the business, ensuring customers can be onboarded, billed, supported, collected from and serviced accurately as Omni's standalone C2C capability comes online. Omni is a newly separated business operating under a Transition Service Agreement (TSA) with its former parent, Thomson Reuters (TR). At Day 1, only Order Entry sits within Omni; Billing, Cash Application, Collections and Master Data continue to be delivered by TR under the TSA. This role will lead the stand-up of standalone C2C capability, progressively bringing each function out of TSA scope and into Omni ownership according to the agreed transition roadmap, with all TSA-covered C2C services fully transitioned before TSA expiry. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong people management, operational discipline, customer focus and the ability to learn quickly in a complex environment. The successful candidate will bring clarity to ownership, simplify processes, improve speed and predictability, and build a high-performing team that supports sales, finance, customer experience and regional business leaders. About The Role In this opportunity as Director Customer to Cash, your key responsibilities will be: Operational Leadership Lead the end-to-end Customer to Cash operating model, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent execution across order processing, billing, cash application, collections and master data. Ensure customers are invoiced accurately and on time, with clear ownership of exceptions, adjustments, cancellations, refunds, credits and dispute handling. Oversee order, billing, cash application and collections processes across relevant platforms, including e Store, Salesforce/Conga, SAP, Bill Trust and Esker. Lead collections activity, including customer outreach, dispute coordination, delinquency escalation and business-directed service suspension or reinstatement. TSA Transition & Carve-Out Lead the C2C stand-up for Omni as a newly separated business operating under a Transition Service Agreement (TSA) with its former parent, Thomson Reuters (TR); at Day 1, only Order Entry sits within Omni, with Billing, Cash Application, Collections and Master Data continuing to be delivered by TR under the TSA. Own the TSA exit plan for each C2C function still delivered by TR, partnering with TR and internal stakeholders to agree hard cutover dates and ensure every TR-provided C2C service is replaced, migrated or stood up independently before TSA expiry. Partner with Technology, Finance and Commercial Excellence to sequence system and process separation, minimizing customer and cash-flow disruption throughout the transition. Establish standalone governance, controls and documentation for C2C processes previously reliant on TR systems or shared services, ensuring SOX compliance and audit-readiness across all six Omni New Co legal entities. Provide regular TSA exit status reporting to senior leadership, flagging risks to cutover dates or service continuity. People & Customer Leadership Lead, coach and develop a geographically distributed team across C2C disciplines, creating clear accountability, decision rights and escalation paths. Build team capability as the role expands from Order Entry into Billing, Cash Application, Collections and Master Data, strengthening knowledge transfer and business continuity. Act as a senior point of contact for Sales, Commercial Excellence, Finance and regional business leaders on C2C issues, risks and opportunities. Build a customer-obsessed culture that reduces friction, improves billing accuracy and resolves issues quickly, supporting scalable processes for e Commerce, reseller and B2B/B2C workflows. Provide confident, visible leadership through organizational change, including communications that help transferring employees feel supported and connected to the new business. Governance & Continuous Improvement Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs and controls across Order Management, Billing, Cash Application, Collections and Master Data. Track performance metrics such as order turnaround time, invoice accuracy, cash application automation, aged debt and dispute resolution, and ensure quality control over customer and financial transactions. Simplify ways of working, reduce ambiguity around ownership and handoffs, and identify opportunities to automate or standardize manual processes. Partner with Finance and Technology on cash flow, receivables and future-state operating model design beyond the initial TSA exit. About You You're a fit for the role of Director Customer to Cash if your background includes: Significant leadership experience, minimum 15 years in Customer to Cash, Order to Cash, Finance Operations, Shared Services, Billing, Collections, Order Management or related operational functions, including managing managers or multi-site, geographically distributed teams. Proven experience leading Customer to Cash, Order to Cash or Finance Operations through a carve-out, joint venture or divestiture, including operating under a Transition Service Agreement (TSA) with a former parent company. Strong understanding of end-to-end customer, order, invoice, payment, collections and dispute processes in high-volume transactional environments where accuracy and turnaround times are critical. Experience working with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Conga, High Radius, Bill Trust, Esker or comparable platforms. Strong process improvement mindset and commercial awareness, including payment terms, credit limits, customer segmentation, e Commerce operations and revenue/cash flow implications. Comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed, ambiguous environment, with excellent communication skills for senior leaders and frontline teams alike. Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related discipline; a professional qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA, CA, CMA) or MBA is a plus. Preferred: background in shared services or global business services (particularly India and/or Philippines delivery models); experience across multiple carve-outs, joint ventures or standalone transitions; and familiarity with subscription, e Commerce or B2B/B2C billing environments. #LI-NG1 What’s in it For You? title: Lead Engineer C++/C#
jobDescription:
Lead Engineer C++/C#: Are you ready to lead the engineering charge on a cutting-edge video streaming platform — and shape the future of how the world's most trusted news organisation delivers media at scale? At Thomson Reuters, we clarify the complex — and we need a technical leader who can do the same for our codebase. We're looking for a Full-Stack C++ / C# Lead Engineer to join our video streaming team, on a hybrid basis, ideally based between UK and India time zones. In this role, you'll serve as the technical lead for a team of junior and senior developers, driving quality, architecture, and delivery on a modern, evolving stack — currently around 80% C++, transitioning toward C#, with a Node.js/Type Script component and legacy PHP being phased out. This is a hybrid position working between UK & India time zones, with some flexibility. title: Associate E-File Analyst (US Tax Forms - 1040/1041)
jobDescription:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Assurance professional to ensure the accuracy and reliability of Gosystem and Ultra Tax products (1040,1041, 1065 & 1120 Tax Types). This role involves rigorous testing, issue management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to maintain high-quality standards and drive process improvements. About the

ROLE:
Perform comprehensive QA testing for Gosystem/Ultra Tax products, including forms and MTB regression testing before and after releases. Accurately document issues in the tracker, follow up with developers, and ensure timely resolution and closure. Test assigned states thoroughly within timelines, maintaining quality benchmarks and compliance standards. Analyze locators/scenarios for correct tax calculations and validate system outputs using state guidelines and FAQs. Collaborate with BAs and managers on issue resolution, cross-product training, and ad-hoc project deliverables. Obtain XSD schemas from US State and Federal government sources and develop master schemas for each state. Map various codes and attributes from the XSD schema to the software to generate accurate XML output. Apply appropriate mapping techniques to ensure correct XML generation. Create diverse test scenarios using locators to validate software functionality and generate XML outputs. Submit test samples to the State jurisdictions and get the Forms/Efile Approval Support US developers on critical support calls/tickets, ensuring smooth production releases. Stay updated on product changes, compliance requirements, and complete mandatory e Learning courses during downtime. About You: Graduate or Postgraduate in any field with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficient in U.S. tax technicals and compliance return preparation. Hands-on experience in QA testing techniques, issue tracking, and regression testing. Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines. Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with developers, BAs, and stakeholders. Basic AI Skills: Familiarity with AI tools like Copilot for improving efficiency and automating routine tasks. Ability to leverage AI for test case generation, data analysis, and process optimization.
